Admin.createHint: Create a circle in preparation, then activate it when the members and schedule are ready.
Admin.assignLaterHint: You can assign a supervisor later. The circle remains inactive until the app admin activates it.
Admin.editHint: Update the circle’s name and description.
Admin.preferencesDescription: Choose the language and appearance of your administration workspace.
Admin.title: Platform administration
Admin.description: Manage users and learning circles, and appoint their supervisors.
Admin.empty: No circles yet. Create your first circle to get started.
Admin.search: Find an account by name or email
Admin.searchHint: The supervisor must first create a personal account.
Admin.replaceHint: The previous supervisor will remain a member. The new supervisor becomes the meeting host.
Admin.deleteHint: This permanently deletes the circle and its assignments, meetings and attendance. Type the circle name to confirm.
Admin.failed: Could not save. Please check the details and try again.
Admin.activeMeeting: End the active meeting before changing the supervisor or deleting the circle.
Admin.name: Circle name
Admin.activeHint: The circle workflow is enabled. Members can prepare assignments and attend meetings.
Admin.inactiveHint: Invitations, members, and schedules can be prepared. The app admin activates the circle when everyone is ready.
Admin.activateHint: The workflow will begin with the next scheduled meeting. Unfinished assignments with past dates will move to that meeting.
Admin.deactivateHint: Meetings, assignments, reminders, and attendance tracking will pause. Members, progress, and history will be kept. You can continue preparing members and schedules.
Admin.activationActiveMeeting: End the live meeting before deactivating this circle.
Admin.activationSupervisorRequired: Assign a supervisor before activating the circle.
Admin.activationScheduleRequired: Set up a meeting schedule before activating the circle.

users.title: User management
users.description: Find an account, help with access, or give a learner a fresh start.
users.empty: No users match your search. Try another name or clear the filters.
users.emptyInitial: No learners have joined yet. Their accounts will appear here after signup.
users.name: User
users.noCircles: This user has not joined a circle.
users.accountDescription: Account information, learning records, and support actions.
users.dataHint: Counts represent saved records, including history, rather than memorized ayahs.
users.actionsHint: Changes apply to this account across devices.
users.resetHint: Clear personal app data and return this user to initial setup.
users.suspendHint: Block sign-in and end existing sessions. Learning data stays saved.
users.reactivateHint: Allow this user to sign in again with their existing account.
users.sign_outHint: End all sign-in sessions and disconnect reminders on registered devices. The user can sign in again.
users.protected: The platform administrator is protected from these actions.
users.supervisorHint: Transfer this user’s supervision responsibilities before resetting their data or suspending access. Use the circle links below.
users.resetDescription: This permanently clears the data listed below, removes circle memberships, and signs the user out. They will start setup again when they return.
users.keepHint: Name, email, password, and account identity. Assignments and reviews belonging to other learners, and the administration log, are preserved. Offline Quran downloads and device-only counters stay on each device.
users.suspendedResetHint: This account will stay suspended until you reactivate it.
users.previewFailed: Could not load the reset preview. Close this dialog and try again.
users.emailConfirmation: Type this user’s email to confirm
users.reasonHint: Add a short explanation for the administration log. Do not include passwords or private learning notes.
users.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the user requested a fresh start.

success.reset: App data reset. The user can start fresh.

errors.unauthorized: Only the platform admin can manage accounts.
errors.invalid: Check the details and enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
errors.protected: The platform admin account cannot be changed here.
errors.stale: This account changed. The page has refreshed; review the latest details and try again.
errors.confirmation: The email does not match this account.
errors.supervisor: Replace this user as circle supervisor before continuing.
errors.active_meeting: End this supervisor’s live meeting before signing out their devices.
errors.failed: The change could not be saved. Try again.

users.historyHint: Account actions, their reasons, and the administrator who made them.
